arguments.prompt:
Create one standalone logo proposal screen for the personal brand “Jovina Diniz”.

This screen must contain ONLY one logo concept for review.

**LOGO DIRECTION:** Premium seal/emblem.
Develop a refined emblem built around the initials JD and the name Jovina Diniz. It should work as a sophisticated personal seal for social avatar, printed materials and website use, with clean structure and strong small-size recognition. Include the descriptor “Terapeuta Integrativa & Mentora de Mulheres”.

**PRESENTATION:** One primary emblem, one horizontal name lockup, and one small seal application. Label the screen “Opção 06”.

Do not use generic therapy/wellness symbols and avoid lotus, butterfly, brain, heart, hands, female silhouette, tree, moon phases, mandala, generic leaf, infinity symbol, medical cross.
